eintraege.titel: Hamas political official and wife among eight Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza
eintraege.text: The killings are the latest from a series of near daily attacks by Israel against what it says are Hamas targets.

eintraege.titel: Was Japan Prime Minister Takaichi Snubbed at China’s Big Summit?
eintraege.text: Images show the differences between the welcomes afforded to Sanae Takaichi and other world leaders in Shenzhen, as some officials in Japan cry foul.

eintraege.titel: Deadly fire erupts near Cairo killing dozens of people
eintraege.text: At least 31 people have died in a large fire on a busy highway in Cairo, after a fuel tanker overturned, says Egypt's health ministry.

eintraege.titel: Kommentar: Warum sich der Traum von niedrigen Strompreisen nicht erfüllen wird
eintraege.text: Die Bundesregierung hilft der Industrie, doch die Effekte sind begrenzt. Grundlegende Verbesserungen sind nicht in Sicht.
